Learner notes for **CSC2529** (Computational Imaging, University of Toronto, instructor David Lindell). Each lecture week is a chapter under `lectures/`. Preview with `quarto preview` from this directory, or open `_site/index.html` after `quarto render`.

Course site: [cs.toronto.edu/~lindell/teaching/2529](https://cs.toronto.edu/~lindell/teaching/2529/). Each week separates material drawn from the lecture, problem session, and homework from prerequisite background the notes add to fill gaps the course assumes but does not teach.
